Should this short-circuit the work of parsing the tokens and check for verb::get at the top of the function and just return false there?

Or is the res header update needed/desired even if not doing the verb::get?

> Should this short-circuit the work of parsing the tokens and check for verb::get at the top of the function and just return false there?

No, because http2 requests can be started with any any verb.

> 
> Or is the res header update needed/desired even if not doing the verb::get?

Correct.  Http header update is required on any verb.
Looks good to me, although I don't have the experience in this area to truly evaluate the implications of the change.
